description: Expected verdicts for the MiSTer Apple IIgs custom diagnostics booted under POMIIGS (tools/mister_diags.py). `expect` = pass | xfail; every xfail names the emulator gap it tracks. An unexpected PASS is reported so the entry can be promoted.

tests.note: 26/26 since CYAREG shadow-all ($C036 b4), the NEWVIDEO bank latch, the floating bus and the LC physical layout are modelled (fpi_shadowall_test pins the same cases)
prints FAIL then BRKs into the monitor at $21FA — SCC register sequence of ROM selftest 06-01
A-TX→B-RX / B-TX→A-RX through the serializers: POMIIGS only models per-channel loopback

corpus dispute: the test polls $C027 bit 7 for command completion, but that bit is mouse-data-only per the Apple IIgs Hardware Reference and the current MiSTer adb.v (their older RTL folded pending command data into it); a data-less bus command leaves b5 clear too. POMIIGS answers the $80 status at $C026 as the test expects, so it fails only on the poll
needs the ADB µC firmware (341-0632) — hangs after 'T' without it
unit $60 (5.25" WOZ via the IWM bit-cell path), 6/6
hour and minute are printed as hex bytes
RAM test overwrites the RAM launcher (inherent to launching from $2000); sequential selftest_trace covers it
RAM address test overwrites the RAM launcher; sequential selftest_trace covers it
the launcher only checks the carry; the ROM's checksum of the ADB µC firmware is gated separately (rom03_selftest_9)

the shadow test fills the text page with $DA ('Z'); needs the ~200 µs ADB response latency, otherwise the ROM IRQ manager steals the µC version byte in the PLP…SEI gap of $FF:6F9A/$6FBF when ProDOS has enabled the DATAREG interrupt
interrupt test: passes only when the periodic Mega II/VGC interrupts run (diag_trace calls frameTick like the emulator loop)
the Ensoniq test needs ~40 s of emulated time
